programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La bebé de Isaak y Paula murió mientras dormía, ella lo culpa porque cuando era niño lo acusaron de asesinato. Demandan a pareja gay que llamó a la policía para denunciar supuesto acto sexual.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Crisis de opioides; El cartel de las ex
programme.desc: Yeny pide el divorcio porque su esposo, Héctor, se ha vuelto adicto a los medicamentos. Rodrigo saca a su hija de su país porque fue víctima de un complot de la madre con psicólogos corruptos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Aire mortal; El emú y la esmeralda
programme.desc: Ernesto sufre las consecuencias de tener un vecino obsesionado con las armas. Además, Lily exige que un emú sea operado porque se tragó la esmeralda que estaba en su anillo de matrimonio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Radio de la frontera; Calientes, pero quietos
programme.desc: Valentina y Juan tienen un programa radial sin audiencia, cuando él cambia el enfoque pone en peligro a los inmigrantes indocumentados. Los maniquíes semidesnudos de Cairo molestan a su vecina.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Dos bebés fueron cambiados al nacer en el hospital. Santiago y Andrés, ahora adolescentes, se enfrentan a una verdad que altera sus vidas y la de sus padres.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Raquel es una abogada de divorcios despiadada. Ella sufre un infarto y descubre que necesita un trasplante de corazón. Sus sentimientos cambian y decide abandonar su carrera.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Lobo aparece con una invitación para Constanza. Plutarco tiene una nueva cita con Gloria y cuando menos lo esperan, una fiesta de adolescentes interrumpe la noche de todos.

programme.title: 100 días para enamorarnos
programme.desc: Las pruebas contra Lobo son muchas y Constanza se las entrega a Plutarco. Al sentirse desenmascarado, Ramírez intenta demostrar su inocencia, pero acorralado saca sus garras.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Luego de hacer el amor con Roxana y comprometerse a construir un futuro juntos, Daniel atiende la llamada del capitán Ferrer. Madre escapa del hospital. Rodiles se enmascara para hacer negocios.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Rodiles provoca una fuga masiva, anuncia el fin de Las Dunas y compensa la lealtad de La Puma, liberándola. Guillotina hiere de bala al comandante David.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: A la cabeza de su nuevo cártel, Los Jinetes Jíbaros, Guillotina jura degollar a Nemesio, a Roxana y a Daniel. Rodiles advierte a Laborde que no soportaría su traición. Le disparan a Fermín.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Roxana huye de la balacera en la hacienda de Los Mil Cumbres, cita a su hermano, Alejandro, y le confiesa quién es, frente a la tumba de sus padres. Bere Bere hiere de bala a Daniel.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: La rivalidad entre Roxana Rodiles y Alejandro Ferrer no tiene límites. Daniel está listo para huir con ella y reorganizar el cartel de Mil Cumbres. La policía despliega un operativo.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: El Berebere amenaza a Roxana con matar a su amiga el Puma, si no accede a encontrarse con él. Rodiles hace un plan y le envía un paquete a Ferrer. Martín insiste en invertir en el negocio.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: Tras las rejas, el Puma se convierte en una pieza importante para la investigación y captura de Berebere. Ferrer no es el único que quiere atrapar a Rodiles, así que trabaja con Camacho.

programme.title: Enemigo íntimo
programme.desc: El rostro de Roxana Rodiles aparece en todo Vigo, por orden de Camacho. Elisa, la abogada del "Profesor", le recomienda mantenerse lejos de la policía y evitar que la atrapen en España.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Federico y Mónica pierden a su hijo Jorgito justo el día del nacimiento de Pablito. El padre, ante el dolor, se entrega a la bebida y abandona a su familia, pero los lazos de amor siempre pueden recuperarse.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Esperanza regresa a México después de pasar seis años en Estados Unidos. Su hija menor no la reconoce y el mayor la trata con frialdad. Cuando se descubre su cáncer, todos cambian de actitud.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Patricio se casa con Rosa María porque está embarazada, sin saber que Delia también espera un hijo suyo. Con el tiempo, Edna y Mariana se convierten en amigas, aunque no tienen idea del lazo que las une.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: Eugenia está a punto de perder la vista, pero su familia no tiene recursos para una cirugía. Conoce a Daniel y el amor florece, pero una amenaza familiar pone en peligro la posibilidad de que estén juntos.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. Suddenly, Sue and her hearing dog, Levi, are "G-Men," involved in a lot more action than they bargained for. This series is loosely based on the real-life deaf FBI agent Sue Thomas.

programme.desc: While on a road trip through a desert, mild-mannered high-school teacher Ralph Hinkley (temporarily changed to Ralph Hanley for part of season one due to real-life current events) is greeted by extraterrestrials, who present him with an extraordinary red flying suit that imbues him with uncanny powers. Learning of the suit, high-strung FBI agent Bill Maxwell convinces Ralph to help him fight crime. Ralph's girlfriend, attorney Pam Davidson, also knows of his secret life as a superhero.

programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. An FBI agent discovers her ability to read lips and promotes Sue to an elite surveillance team. programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: This sprawling family saga takes place where an unfortunate tragedy has glued a family together to pull them through life's thick and thin moments. Follow young Amy Fleming as she slowly discovers she possesses her now-deceased mother's ability to aid injured horses as well as maintaining good relationships with those who are trying to get by one day at a time. The family pursues forgotten dreams and challenges as their strength is tested against personal struggles.

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. programme.title: The Daytrippers

Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process.

programme.title: Catfish

Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding

After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: Rio Diablo
programme.desc: Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

programme.title: Barbarosa
programme.desc: In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert -- and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulito (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead.

programme.title: Cash Cab
programme.desc: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host.

programme.title: Incident at Oglala
programme.desc: Robert Redford narrates this documentary about the Pine Ridge Shootout on an Oglala Sioux reservation in South Dakota. On June 26, 1975, two FBI agents are searching for tribesman Leonard Peltier, wanted in connection with an assault. They are killed after coming under heavy fire, presumably from Peltier and his accomplices. However, proponents claim that the FBI botched the investigation by tampering with and suppressing evidence, and that Peltier's imprisonment is a miscarriage of justice.

programme.title: The Exiles
programme.desc: In a Native American neighborhood in Los Angeles, Homer (Homer Nish) lives with his pregnant wife, Yvonne (Yvonne Williams), in a crowded apartment. While Homer goes drinking with his friend Tommy (Tom Reynolds), Yvonne is left at a movie by herself. As the men get progressively drunker, Yvonne realizes her husband is not coming home. Meanwhile, Homer and Tommy wander through the nighttime city, looking for fights, playing poker and discussing their problems as Native Americans.

programme.title: The Silent Enemy

Chief Chetoga agrees with the hunter Baluk to move north toward the caribou herds, despite the protests of Dagwan, the medicine man. After the move, hunting proves unsuccessful, despite the numerous animals around them. Chetoga's daughter, Neewa (Spotted Elk) mocks Baluk, but when Chetoga dies, he is made the new chief. When his people remain without food, the tribe turns against him.

programme.title: Ramona

programme.title: DuckTales
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck is back in this reboot of the late-'80s animated series. He gains guardianship of grandnephews Huey, Dewey and Louie when Donald Duck reluctantly takes them to McDuck Manor, the wonder of which enthralls the mischievous triplets. While living with their trillionaire relative, the boys learn long-held family secrets and unleash symbolic artifacts from Scrooge's past. The threesome's antics send the family on a number of adventures, which include Webby Vanderquack, the granddaughter of Scrooge's housekeeper, Mrs. Beakley. The show's animation style is inspired by the classic comic designs of animator Carl Barks.
